summary: Weibo Corporation filed a Form 6-K on May 27, 2026, reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on the same day. The sole business was the re-election of three directors: Charles Guowei Chao, Gaofei Wang, and Pochin Christopher Lu, all approved as ordinary resolutions. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisition, divestiture, or management change; this is a routine procedural disclosure of shareholder meeting results. The filing merely satisfies periodic reporting obligations under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. No deal terms or strategic actions are present.
